arStrings.szText: "Do you know what happened to that woman?"
She took part in a "fate urn" ceremony. Created an urn with her own blood to glimpse the future.
I tried to warn them. Fate is never shared freely. The Oracle—
Spare us, Rhea! The only reason you didn’t make one is because you were scared!
And she was right to be! We’re cursed, Petros! Desdemona is dead. Lycus is hiding in a hole in the ground…
Lycus. He shouldn’t be alone. The curse took Desdemona when she was alone.
If he wants to hide, that’s his choice! There is no curse. Our fates are our own.
I’m not scared of some damned piece of pottery.
